Name: Confeitaria do Bolhão
Tips: CLOSED SUNDAYS - departure day is a Sunday, so do NOT plan on it (the famous 06:00 opening is Mon-Fri only, Sat 07:00). Breakfast happens airside at OPO instead; eat Friday's market fruit on the metro.

Name: Bolhão Metro Station
Tips: Line E toward Aeroporto, ~40 min, from ~06:00 on Sundays. Early-Sunday frequency is 20-30 min - if the board shows the next airport train more than 15 min out, switch to a Bolt (~18 EUR, 25-30 min). Leave hotel 06:15, board ~06:25, OPO ~07:05.

Name: Aeroporto Francisco Sá Carneiro (OPO) — airside breakfast
Tips: Clear security by ~07:45 (TAP check-in closes 07:30 for the 09:00 TP1921), then breakfast airside: Aloma (Best Pastel de Nata 2024-25) has an airport shop, plus Costa Coffee and the food court, open from ~05:30. A calm 30 min before the 08:30 gate.
